lines: Thus — the great darkness, taken on with becoming, is dispelled by awareness’s rays:
Death, Yama, the Ender, karma-ghosts — Lord, salutation: never shall I fear.
sanskrit_cite: ittham upoḍhabhavanmayasaṃviddīdhitidāritabhūritamisraḥ mṛtyuyamāntakakarmapiśācaiḥ nātha ! namo'stu na jātu bibhemi
notes: upoḍha read ‘taken on’ (against L0 ‘torn-asunder’); tamisra is darkness (against L0 ‘mixed’)
